params.body:
Two changes in one build: the Meta Pixel comes back behind a cookie banner, and the StockCars social profiles get linked.

## Meta Pixel, only after consent

The pixel (`site.facebookPixelId`) was removed in 3d9cb91 because it was not in use, so since the launch Meta has received nothing.

- `fbevents.js` is not loaded at all until the visitor agrees. This is stricter than `fbq('consent','revoke')` before init, which still fetches the script from connect.facebook.net and so sends Meta the IP address and the page before anyone said yes. The `<noscript>` image is gone because it fired without consent.
- `ConsentBanner.astro`: "Akkoord" and "Weigeren" are identical buttons. The choice is kept for twelve months. Refusing revokes a running pixel and removes `_fbp`/`_fbc`. "Cookie-instellingen" in the footer opens the banner again.
- Events (`autoConfig` off, so only these):
  - `PageView` on every page.
  - `ViewContent` on a car detail page, with the id, title and price in EUR.
  - `Lead` after a form is sent. For the Netlify forms it fires on the thank-you page, once and not on a reload. The car question form fires it on success.
- The privacy page gets a section on the pixel. It is seed content, so it goes live after `npm run seed` in `studio/`.
- The site sets no Content-Security-Policy, so there is nothing to widen.

## Social links

- Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok appear as icons beside the contact details: in the contact block on the home and in the footer's Contact column on the other pages. They are not in the top navigation.
- Each opens in a new tab with `rel="noopener"` and has a name for screen readers.
- The URLs live in `site.social`, and `Schema.astro` lists all four in `sameAs`. The `&` in the LinkedIn slug is encoded as `%26`.

## Checked locally

Playwright against the production build:
- Before a choice there are no requests to facebook.com or connect.facebook.net and no `_fb*` cookies.
- After accepting, `fbevents.js` loads and `facebook.com/tr` receives PageView, ViewContent and Lead.
- After refusing, or accepting and then refusing via the footer, nothing goes out and the cookies are gone.
- No console errors.
- `vitest` passes (46 tests). `test/pixel.test.ts` covers the thank-you pages and the ViewContent payload.

Note: `fbevents.js` sends nothing from a HeadlessChrome user agent, so a check needs a regular Chrome UA.
params.title: Meta Pixel after consent, and links to the social profiles
